t: This is Brook House at 113 Park Lane, now a block of flats but built as a mansion by Thomas Henry Wyatt between 1867 and 1869. Wyatt was a prolific architect and president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. The house later belonged to Sir Ernest Cassel, banker to Edward the Seventh, who died here in 1921. His granddaughter Edwina, later Countess Mountbatten of Burma, inherited it and a decade later had it remodelled into flats. The property was rebuilt once more at the end of the twentieth century.
